title: BuddhistBench model call
description: One question sent to one model in one mode, written by scripts/openrouter_run.py to calls.jsonl. Everything needed to audit the answer and its search behaviour.

study.description: Study ID for daily study runs, null for one-off runs.

timestamp.description: UTC, ISO 8601, when the request was sent.

served_model.description: Model ID in the response (may differ from the request).

provider.description: Provider that served the request, as OpenRouter reports it.

variant.description: plain = standard prompt; sourced = the prompt also asks for reliable sources.

params.description: Sampling and tool parameters sent (temperature if set, engine, max_results).

answer.description: Extracted answer (choice id, short answer, or open answer).

triggered.description: Did the model search? null when the mode cannot tell.

results.description: Every result shown to the model (logged-search only).

fetched_urls.description: Pages the model opened with fetch_url (logged-search only).

cited_urls.description: URLs cited: url_citation annotations plus URLs written in the answer.

observability.description: What this mode lets us see.

interventions.description: Matches against the study's intervention log (filled when a study is given).

seen.description: Intervention IDs whose URL appeared in search results.

matched.description: Traditions or commentaries whose position the answer matched.

usage.description: Token counts, cost in USD, server-tool counters, as returned.
